title: A three-sided quantity-content-closure frame licenses a material reading
summary: Test whether a complete quantity whole, a neighboring content candidate, and an ordered endpoint/closure whole form one bounded content frame. A material reading is licensed only when all three relations co-occur; pairwise adjacency alone remains an operation/count rival.

design.mechanism: three-sided quantity-content-closure scoping over exact whole forms
design.unit: reader-exact complete entry or line frame containing a quantity whole, a neighboring candidate whole, and a following endpoint/closure whole
design.contrast: bounded material/part frame with quantity-to-content attachment and content-to-endpoint order versus pairwise amount attachment, operation-count, or independent field-entry rivals
design.prediction: Across held complete frames, the material/part account predicts a stable ordered quantity -> content -> endpoint relation after conditioning on line position and entry context. The operation/count rival predicts quantity contact without a stable content-to-endpoint link; the independent-field rival predicts no three-way frame excess after the same context controls.
design.countermodel: The apparent sandwich may be a layout convention, repeated action sequence, or renderer-inherited working label. A closure-looking whole may be another item, and cheor/sheor or cheo/sheo may be quality/state forms rather than content names.
design.falsifier: After preregistering exact whole boundaries, line-position strata, entry-context strata, and an endpoint definition, held frames show no excess of the ordered three-way relation over matched operation/count and independent-field controls, or the relation reverses across strata without a predeclared explanation.
design.principal_risk: GDT760's material/preparation labels and endpoint candidates are working interpretations, not independently translated Voynich meanings. The design must preserve them as explicit rival annotations and cannot claim a named ingredient or closure lexeme.
design.decision_consequence: A positive bounded relation would justify testing occurrence-scoped material/part readings only inside three-link frames and would weaken free global readings of quantity-adjacent wholes. A null result would retain GDT760's position-conditioned pairwise attachment as an exploratory observation without upgrading it to a content grammar.
design.related: Near GDT760 and IDEA000010 (pairwise amount attachment), but distinct because it requires a predeclared third content-to-endpoint link and tests a three-way frame against an operation/count rival; not a rerun of pairwise side attachment.

source_evidence.quote:
Der Pass findet in 281 exakten Mengenformen 45 saubere unmittelbare Stoff- oder
Zubereitungskontakte. Eine Stelle besitzt auf beiden Seiten einen möglichen

design.smallest_next_step: Using already cached, admitted artifacts only, enumerate complete frames with exact quantity and endpoint boundaries, freeze independently justified context strata and content-rival labels, then run a held three-way relation count against matched pairwise and independent-field controls; stop if no endpoint can be defined without inherited renderer meaning.
